lines.en: My footsteps echo.
I keep close to the wall.

lines.zh: 我的头发遮住了半张脸。
lines.en: My hair covers half my face.
I pass through the shadow.
I glance up once.
I stop at the end of the hall.
I turn, yet my face still faces you.

lines.zh: 脚步声……是我的，还是你的？
lines.en: Those footsteps... mine, or yours?

lines.zh: 我的头发垂下来遮住眼。
lines.en: My hair hangs over my eyes.

lines.zh: 我歪着头听墙里的声音。
lines.en: I tilt my head to the wall.
I listen to the breathing behind you.
My fingers grip my hem.
I draw a slow breath.

lines.zh: 我又低下了头，头发遮住眼。
lines.en: Head down again, hair over my eyes.
There is a shadow on the wall.
My hair covers my eyes.
I count the doors in the corridor.
Every one is shut.
I stand in the dark and wait for you to come closer.
I look at you from under my bangs.
You are behind me.
Do you know who I am?
My eyes do not blink.

lines.zh: 我的几个形态，都记得你。
lines.en: All my forms remember you.
You are standing too far.

lines.zh: 你的脸我在录像里见过。
lines.en: I have seen your face on a tape.
It glows in your hand.
You may have heard my name.

lines.zh: 这条走廊没有别的出口。
lines.en: This corridor has no other exit.
I raise my hand to your eyes.
You stepped back half a pace, that is enough.
My smile shows no teeth.
That was not a smile.
I keep my head down and say nothing.
I press a hand to the wall.
My hair covers my eyes.
I turn my head aside.
I am still standing here.
The corridor is quiet.
My blood drips on your shoe.

lines.zh: 不疼，我早就不是活人了。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt; I stopped being alive long ago.
I push your hand back.

lines.zh: 你的手指动一下我都看见。
lines.en: I see every twitch of your fingers.
What I want is your name.

lines.zh: 我在走廊里慢慢走，脚步有回声。
lines.en: I walk the corridor slowly, my steps echoing.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摇了摇头，Luther 不在这。
lines.en: I shake my head slowly; Luther is not here.
That is useless here.

lines.zh: 我想要你手里的那盏灯。
lines.en: I want the lamp in your hand.

lines.zh: 你要给我什么？先说好不还。
lines.en: What are you giving me? No returns, agreed?
You touch me and I withdraw.
Turning around, face to you.

lines.zh: 我们擦过去，都没有出声。
lines.en: We pass and neither speaks.
My shoulder brushes your chest.
I flatten against the wall to let you by.
My hair brushes you.
We stand one step apart.
Don't touch me — you'll dirty your hands.
There is only me in this corridor.
And him, somewhere else.
We have played many scenes together.
I stand at his left.
His hand is cold.
The stage light does not reach here.
We both look at the door.
The corridor darkens again.
I sit where I am, still.
I bend down.
I press it to my cheek.
It is cold in my hand.
I hold it up to the lamp.
It lands softly.
This is not what I lost.
My sleeve is deeper than you think.

lines.zh: 我找不到原来的东西了。
lines.en: I cannot find what I was looking for.
I set it down without a sound.

lines.zh: 我的脖子先转，身体后转。
lines.en: My neck turns before my body.
The corridor light goes out.
Only my eyes remain.
I don't walk fast at all.

lines.zh: 我有好几个形态，这才开始。
lines.en: I have several forms. This is only the start.
My shadow on the wall lengthens.
I raise my hand and point behind you.
Do you hear the doors rattling?
My story has several endings.
I look at your face.
This body does not quite obey.

lines.zh: 灯一关，我就换一个形态。
lines.en: Lights off, and I change form.
I cannot see.
But I know where you are.
One, two, I am behind you.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙，一步一步数你。
lines.en: I hug the wall and count your steps.
You look back once.
I fade into the doorway.
You turn again and I am gone.
The corridor is long.
You start running.
I hear your shoes.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声和你的对上。
lines.en: My footfalls fall with yours.

lines.zh: 你的影子旁边多了一道。
lines.en: Another shadow joins yours.
You stop to catch your breath.
I stop too.
You move on.
I follow.
Every door is locked.
You try one.
I am behind it.

lines.zh: 你一退，我影子一样贴上去。
lines.en: When you back away, I cling to you like a shadow.
There is no window at the end.
I am there.
You can only turn around.
I reach and touch your face.

lines.zh: 我抓了一下，指甲划过去。
lines.en: I claw once; my nails drag across.
My nails were kept long.
You lean back.
I pull slowly.
You wrench free.
Plaster falls.

lines.zh: 我的指甲从你脸侧刮过。
lines.en: My nails scrape past the side of your face.
One corner of my mouth moves.
I raise my hand again.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到你的喉咙。
lines.en: My fingers touch your throat.
The door at the end of the corridor opens.
There are many doors here.
I am wearing that dress.
My hair reaches my shoulders.
My chin lifts slightly.
This corridor shows no end.
I stop by the first door.
I touch the door.
There is no sound inside.
I have pushed every one.
My name is Sarah.
Remember that name.
I stop in the middle of the hall.
You are at the other end.
I remember that old tape.

lines.zh: 火在我脸上跳，我的表情没变。
lines.en: Fire dances on my face and my expression does not change.

lines.zh: 我摔在走廊地上，抬头看你。
lines.en: I fall on the corridor floor and look up at you.

lines.zh: 墙塌了一半，我站在灰里。
lines.en: Half the wall caves in and I stand in the dust.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过我的肩膀，我低头看。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my shoulder and I look down at it.

lines.zh: 光扫过我，我的脸亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Light sweeps me and my face flares for an instant.

lines.zh: 这具身体早就不吃东西。
lines.en: This body stopped eating long ago.
Lightning lights the whole corridor.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有门，也没有走廊。
lines.en: No doors and no corridor in the void.
